reply.summary: Seolanore is a rooftop burglar who slips through shuttered windows on silent feet and boasts of a handful of spare lives bought from a village healer. Locals swear the thief has already cheated the gallows more than once.

feats.scene: Swinging a weighted sack, the burglar knocks a shutter clean off its hinges.
Tumbling from a tiled roof onto a hay cart, the thief bounces up and sprints away.

reply.summary: Sellalli is a languid trickster spirit who rules every stray animal in the district and wears a human face only when it suits the mood. Dying merely sends the spirit off to curl up as a house pet for a while, though the supply of returns is limited.

feats.scene: Snapping long fingers, the trickster hurls a stack of crates across a warehouse floor.
Shot through the chest in a crowded alley, the spirit stands again within a minute.

reply.summary: Tiacanus is a petty brigand who insists a witch doctor granted a clutch of extra lives and acts with the swagger of a man who cannot be hurt. Guards who watched the criminal serve a long sentence disagree about how many lives are really left.

feats.scene: Hurling a looted anvil-sized strongbox, the brigand cracks a door frame.
Struck by a speeding wagon, the brigand staggers and keeps robbing.

reply.summary: Iaseoria is a hired thug for a drug conglomerate who rearranges the structure of living matter with a gesture, locking victims into stillness. Mercenary work along a sunny coast ended when two clever adversaries forced a reversal of the trick.

feats.scene: Raising a gloved palm, the mercenary stiffens an entire running man into rigid stone-like matter.
Slammed against a brick wall by two pursuers, the hireling grunts and slumps.

reply.summary: Sonle is a retired concert vocalist who hides in plain sight as a tidy domestic worker under a borrowed nickname, escaping a suitor with a fixation. Years of scrubbing floors have left a dry wit and a surprisingly firm grip.

feats.scene: Swinging a heavy cast skillet, the housekeeper drives an intruder out the door.
Shoved down a short flight of stairs, the singer rises and brushes off her apron.

reply.summary: Lasralo is a vigilante sealed inside heavy plate styled like a vaulted nave, patrolling alleys as a righteous terror to cutthroats. The armour shrugs off cannon fire, though careless brawls leave whole streets cracked and smoking.

feats.scene: Hurling a rooftop water tank, the armoured brute flattens a row of garden sheds.
Caught in a vast blast from above, the armour glows white before finally buckling.

reply.summary: Llimia is a devout precinct captain with mechanical wings strapped to a broad, muscular frame, who flies low over crowded avenues to run down felons. Faith and duty occasionally collide in the squad room, but never in the air.

feats.scene: Diving feet first, the officer drives a bandit through a wooden fence.
Beating her wings hard, the airborne officer overtakes a fleeing motorcycle.

reply.summary: Selleme is a sharp-tongued newsroom columnist in a mirrored metropolis who trades gossip for leverage and sells out colleagues without a blink. Nothing about the schemer is supernatural, only ruthless and well connected.

feats.scene: Slapping a rival across the face, the columnist leaves a red print on his cheek.
Tripped on the press room stairs, the schemer hits the landing and storms off.

reply.summary: Autel is a veteran news writer who survives a plague of mindless crowds by hiding in a studio cut off from every glowing screen. A shimmering barrier conjured by an ally keeps the blast that levels the district from touching her shelter.

feats.scene: Hurling a stapler with all her strength, the reporter dents a ceiling tile.
Huddling inside a glowing shell, the survivor endures the roar of a collapsing skyline.

reply.summary: Anitel is a polished arms dynasty heiress who married into a family of soldiers and now steers a ledger-heavy firm from behind a mahogany desk. Her weapons are contracts, not firearms.

feats.scene: Slamming a ledger on the boardroom table, the executive silences a shouting partner.
Thrown from a startled horse, the heiress gets up and finishes the ride.

reply.summary: Inureoern is a blond industrialist who inherited an arms fortune and slowly became the quiet ally of a masked crusader in the family. The executive uses boardroom clout and discreet funding rather than any fighting talent.

feats.scene: Hauling open a stuck vault door, the businesswoman reveals a hidden cache of rifles.
Knocked sideways in a car park scuffle, the executive recovers and calls for help.

reply.summary: Ulsornen is a civic leader's daughter who refuses to be flattered by an obsessive doctor and is abducted for her stubbornness. Tied to a bed frame for days, the captive keeps her contempt intact until rescue arrives.

feats.scene: Kicking the bed post with both bare heels, the captive splinters it slightly.
Bound for days without food, the prisoner still answers every offer with a flat refusal.

reply.summary: Stivarcor is a redheaded settler's wife on a frontier ranch, remembered mostly as the great-great grandmother of a famed night guardian. Her life of fence-mending and bread-baking is mundane but stubbornly determined.

feats.scene: Swinging a splitting maul, the homesteader cleaves a stout log in one blow.
Kicked by a mule, the rancher rubs the bruise and returns to the churn.

reply.summary: Anunan is a gene-spliced enforcer with hardened talons coated in venom, hired by a criminal syndicate to extinguish rivals. A fatal scratch from his own blades, plus a final detonation, ended a short and cruel run.

feats.scene: Raking his talons across a steel door, the enforcer shreds four deep grooves.
Standing at the heart of a fireball, the enforcer is burned to ash.

reply.summary: Numamanu is a lithe freelance burglar bound by a bargain with something infernal, trading her good fortune for gold and speed. Her lash cracks faster than the eye can follow, but a fire-breathing fiend proves too much.

feats.scene: Cracking a long whip, the burglar rips a padlock off a chain.
Darting across rooftops, the thief outruns a patrol van.
Seized by the skull in a monstrous grip, the burglar is scorched to bone.

reply.summary: Serora is a harbour-city cat burglar of the lantern era who dresses as a hotel servant to get past guards, then vanishes over rooftops with the prize. Acrobatic and clever, the thief still loses to opponents with greater strength.

feats.scene: Whirling in a flurry of kicks, the burglar drops six guards in a dining hall.
Hurled through a paper wall by a stronger fighter, the thief rolls upright.

reply.summary: Tialen is a future-city burglar who can split into a squad of eight identical selves, giving a feline edge in any heist. A sleek powered suit and a cool nerve let the thief rob cities without wanting to see them burn.

feats.scene: Splitting into a crowd of twins, the thief tackles a gunman from every angle at once.
Caught under a collapsing scaffold, the thief absorbs the blow in the padded suit.

reply.summary: Siuile is a mail-clad inheritor of a notorious thief's legacy, quick, feline in manner and a little too proud of the plating. The jailbreak that frees the prisoners also exposes everyone inside to an atomic strike.

feats.scene: Lunging with plated claws, the prisoner gouges a trench in a cell wall.
Standing in the open beneath a distant atomic fireball, the prisoner is incinerated.

reply.summary: Riacinrni is a freelance mercenary in a neon future who inherited a power to clone up to nine bodies at once and uses the gift to rob vaults. Cocky and quick, the thief gambles every copy in a single desperate brawl.

feats.scene: Splitting into nine, the mercenary swarms a hulking guard and bowls him over.
Battered by a sleek armoured foe, the mercenary loses each duplicate in turn.

reply.summary: Anueoria is a mounted lancer clad in dusty regimental red who charges through hedgerows at dawn, a forgotten oddity of country folklore. The rider's thunderous gallop and bent saber make for a better story than a threat.

feats.scene: Charging with a lowered lance, the rider punches through a wooden barricade.
Galloping flat out down a lane, the rider scatters a flock of sheep.

reply.summary: Lloceo is a purple-skinned one-eyed schoolgirl on an island of warriors, forever stuck at her desk finishing lessons while friends go out. Despite the cheerful nature, the student can hurl a boulder across a courtyard when annoyed.

feats.scene: Tossing a garden boulder, the student sends it bouncing across the schoolyard.
Bonked by a swinging door, the child blinks her big eye and giggles.

reply.summary: Liava is a red-haired toddler who babbles in a private language with a playmate and wanders into the strangest misadventures in the nursery. A pacifier and a stuffed doll are the only gear the infant needs.

feats.scene: Flinging a rattle in a tantrum, the toddler bonks the family cat.
Tumbling off the sofa, the baby bounces on the rug and laughs.

reply.summary: Aunmacor is a green-eyed fixer working the sunny coast who quietly brokers deals between smugglers, executives and spies. A pistol in her handbag is the final argument after negotiations fail.

feats.scene: Firing a pistol, the broker drops a bottle off a distant railing.
Slapped by a furious client, the fixer smiles and raises the price.

reply.summary: Riarosveo is a teenage film performer who can turn herself and anyone she grips into mist-like vapour and drift through solid rock. A pet wildcat tags along, ignoring the dangers of every stunt.

feats.scene: Linking hands with friends, the actress glides the whole group through a rockfall.
Floating over a ravine, the performer outpaces a sprinting guard.

reply.summary: Monaniar is a stern landowning lord of an old forest estate who raises an adopted ward beside his own heir and holds fast to heritage. A broadsword hangs above the hearth and sees use when raiders come near.

feats.scene: Swinging a broadsword in a hall, the lord cleaves a thick oak table.
Struck by a thrown stool, the noble keeps his feet and roars.

reply.summary: Laselaau is a horned greedy wanderer who carries a glowing amber ring that feeds on covetousness and takes whatever he sees. Rumour holds that the scavenger once served the dead before changing sides.

feats.scene: Sweeping a ring-bearing arm, the scavenger rips a parked truck from the road.
Hit head-on by a runaway cart, the scavenger stands his ground.

reply.summary: Sivor is a brown-haired ex-corps scavenger who still wields memories of a ring that shaped hard light into barriers and bolts and carried him through the air. Without the band his avarice goes unfed.

feats.scene: Firing a bolt from the band, the scavenger levels a row of derelict tenements.
Wrapped in a glowing shell, the scavenger endures a crashing freighter hull.
Streaking past a lunar outpost, the scavenger leaves a bright vapour trail.

reply.summary: Valserron is a towering monarch of a scorched, sun-baked world who keeps her subjects in chains by tricking runners into dropping their winged footwear. Her stride is fast and her fists are heavy, but her rule rests mostly on cunning.

feats.scene: Slamming both fists into a stone pillar, the queen topples a whole colonnade.
Racing across a hot plateau in winged sandals, the queen outruns a sonic cannon shell.

reply.summary: Sanenuve is a white-haired sentinel commander in a luminous high-rise city of benevolent elder beings, guarding the gates with a stern gaze. Years of war games have made the captain a sharp tactician among her kind.

feats.scene: Slamming a spear into a canyon wall, the captain splits a cliff face in two.
Standing in a rain of siege fire, the captain does not retreat a step.

reply.summary: Cortanllu is a starving cosmic devourer shackled in a distant dimension that tears open a door above a city tenement to feed. Hunger drives the colossus, but the passage demands a living sacrifice before it will open.

feats.scene: Forcing a rift above a skyline, the devourer shakes an entire block of buildings into powder.
Hauled back through the gate by a hoax, the devourer is crushed in the closing portal.

reply.summary: Iumancor is a former carrier-wing flight instructor turned rocket-powered rescuer who patrols bay-side towns after leaving a stubborn command. Her scientist parents' family firm supplies the gear, and the pilot supplies the courage.

feats.scene: Diving through a stuck hangar door, the pilot rips it from its track.
Roaring across the harbour on rocket boots, the pilot overtakes a coast guard cutter.

reply.summary: Anrnues is a medieval noble lady whose soul was cursed by the heavens to be reborn across the centuries, wandering from one life to the next. Her knightly husband rides beside her through each vanishing age.

feats.scene: Hurling a lantern across a banquet hall, the lady sets a tapestry alight.
Cut down in the cathedral courtyard, the noblewoman is born again within a year.

reply.summary: Nutaeon is a black-haired winged prisoner aboard a lonely orbital station who rallies fellow captives to slip out when their jailer is distracted. Antennae twitch as she listens for the guards, and her courage costs her dearly.

feats.scene: Wrenching a lock panel open, the prisoner lets the others out into the corridor.
Struck by a jailer in a rage, the captive collapses and lies still.

reply.summary: Raanrno is a pale hairless brute whose hide is carved with the names of the betrayed, each scar adding to his might. A boastful habit of announcing the source of that strength makes him easy to defeat.

feats.scene: Punching a parked van, the brute flips it onto its roof.
Beaten by three costumed fighters at once, the brute keeps swinging.

reply.summary: Iumanusto is an ancient sentient landmass of the open sea that rescued prehistoric beasts from extinction and later turned against humanity after witnessing a thermonuclear flash. Its jungle fringe teems with mutated winged lizards sent out to gather fuel for escape.

feats.scene: Hauling its mass up from the waves, the island launches a storm of winged lizards over a coastline.
Shelled and burned from the sky, the island entity holds together for hours before it breaks.

reply.summary: Nteteau is a huge triple-headed hound with ember eyes that lopes before the gates of the dead, guarding them for a ruler below. Teeth the length of swords and a deathless hide make it a nightmare for any intruder.

feats.scene: Snapping all three jaws at once, the hound bites a stone statue to rubble.
Struck by a lightning-wrapped spear, the hound shakes it off and howls.

reply.summary: Reseo is a black-furred three-headed watchdog with amber eyes who lurks at the bottom of a torch-lit stair, devouring anything that tries to leave. The beast's growl alone is enough to make armed raiders drop their weapons.

feats.scene: Raking one great paw, the watchdog shears a bronze door in half.
Hit by a catapult stone, the watchdog flinches and leaps at the crew.

reply.summary: Strniva is a monstrous three-necked hound, offspring of two storm-born horrors, who sits before a bronze gate and lets in only the departed. Music, a sweet sauce or a lucky bite on the tail can all slip past its hunger.

feats.scene: Lunging at a hero, the hound crushes a marble column between its jaws.
Slashed across one neck by a trident, the hound regrows a bleeding stump of flesh.

reply.summary: Cerdian is a young sea-folk fighter stolen from a ruined city as an infant and raised as a soldier by a cruel warden. Learning of his true family, the dark-haired youth must pick between old comrades and his birth kin.

feats.scene: Driving a fist into a steel bulkhead, the soldier leaves a deep dent.
Hit by a charging heavy fighter, the youth shakes his head and rises.

reply.summary: Reium is a brown-haired harvest deity of a borrowed pantheon who coaxes crops from barren soil and mourns a daughter lost to the underworld. Fields burst into flower wherever the immortal walks.

feats.scene: Calling up a surge of roots, the goddess heaves a hillside orchard out of the ground.
Struck by a fallen oak, the goddess merely brushes bark from her sleeve.

reply.summary: Telcisnas is a white-eyed elder in a shrunken city kept inside a bottle, sitting on a council that enforces harsh laws until a tragic death changes everything. The blue-skinned sage can leap rooftops and lift stone benches without strain.

feats.scene: Hefting a stone bench overhead, the elder hurls it across a plaza.
Struck by a falling arch, the elder dusts himself off.

reply.summary: Iumreont is a blonde councillor in a miniature city who inherits her father's seat and rewrites the laws for the good of the people. Strong as a loader and hard to bruise, the white-eyed lawmaker joins the defence against a ghostly invader.

feats.scene: Wrenching a cart free of the mud, the councillor flips it onto the road.
Hit by a blast of ghostly force, the councillor stays on her feet.

reply.summary: Oriiumra is a red-eyed antlered deity of beasts, wealth and fertility who lives in an otherworldly forest kept alive by belief. Sent out to broker peace between feuding clans, the god walks into a human city seeking allies.

feats.scene: Stamping a hoof, the god raises a thorny wood that swallows a whole boulevard.
Struck by a siege of spells, the antlered god barely stumbles.

reply.summary: Rasas is a grey-haired matriarch of a deep-sea order of widows who also holds a seat on the kingdom's ruling council. Bred for the crushing depths, the cleric hits hard, moves fast and sees clearly in the black water.

feats.scene: Driving her staff into a coral wall, the matriarch smashes a hole through it.
Hauled down into a trench, the matriarch endures a pressure that would flatten a submarine.
Darting between pillars, the cleric outswims a patrol torpedo.

reply.summary: Covacor is a tiny furry sentinel with a rodent's whiskers who wields a ring of willpower from a distant, small-minded homeworld. The tiny ranger summons barriers and blasts, and once helped capture a conqueror.

feats.scene: Firing a beam from the ring, the ranger blows a hole through a rocky ridge.
Wrapped in a glowing barrier, the ranger withstands a salvo of cannon fire.
Streaking skyward in a bright arc, the ranger leaves the atmosphere behind.

reply.summary: Tumnania is a small auburn trainee with a ring and a charged battery who proves more than a match for a veteran twice his size. A knack for slipping inside a machine's circuits lets the recruit pull a captive mind out of its cage.

feats.scene: Hurling a thick beam from the ring, the recruit shatters a training dummy to flakes.
Tossed into a wall by an older fighter, the recruit pops up unhurt.

reply.summary: Rneol is a brown-furred ranger bound to a sprawling interstellar corps who mentors a young recruit against a swarm of machines. The little guide can only be found in handheld game versions of the tale.

feats.scene: Raising a ring, the ranger blasts a drone cruiser into scrap.
Hit by a volley of metallic bolts, the ranger sheds them in a gleaming shell.

reply.summary: Tillva is a brown-skinned ex-officer of a cosmic police order who tames a tyrant by imagining something so small that the nerves in his skull fail. The ploy ends when a vengeful ex-colleague strikes before the prisoner can be moved.

feats.scene: Squeezing out a ring blast, the ex-officer topples a concrete overpass.
Wrapped in a pale shell, the ex-officer endures an avalanche of debris.

reply.summary: Listival is a diminutive fur-covered ranger stationed on a distant home base, one among many in a roster of fighters from a video game. Whatever shape the wearer imagines, the ring renders it as solid glowing matter.

feats.scene: Conjuring a giant hammer, the ranger flattens an armoured walker.
Struck by a rocket, the ranger sits unharmed inside a glowing dome.

reply.summary: Caniu is a cheerful furred ring-bearer who roams the sky nicknamed with a pet name by teammates and answers calls from remote worlds. The ring supplies barriers, bolts and wings, and the battery keeps it charged.

feats.scene: Casting a green-lit bolt, the ranger blows a tunnel through a mountainside shed.
Rocketing into orbit, the ranger leaves a pale vapour streak across the sky.
